slides.title: Summer is semester time
slides.body: By law, people working in Sweden get at least 25 days of *semester* a year. Many take several weeks in a row in July, and some offices get very quiet.

slides.sv: Vi åker till Gotland på *semester* i juli.
slides.en: We're going to Gotland on vacation in July.

caption:
Semester in Swedish means vacation. If you mean half a school year, the word is termin.

By law, people working in Sweden get at least 25 days of semester a year, and July is when most people take it.

Where would you spend a Swedish summer semester?
